name: calculate
description: Work out an arithmetic expression exactly: sums, percentages, multiplication, division, powers, square roots. Use it for any calculation instead of working it out in your head.

expression.description: plain arithmetic such as 17 * 300 / 100 or sqrt(144) + 2 ^ 5; write 'x percent of y' as x / 100 * y

examples: what is the square root of 144
what is 2 to the power of 10
